Documented Annual Training-15 Hours Required Caregiver: Four caregiver files were reviewed found to be incomplete. Each file did not meet the requirement of having completed a minimum of 15 clock hours of annual training.  The training hours were  incomplete for the following required topics: 747.1309(b)(1) minimum of six clock hours in child growth and development, (2) guidance and discipline, (3) age-appropriate curriculum, and (4)teacher-child interactions; (c)(1-4) at least one clock hour that focuses on prevention, recognition, and reporting of child maltreatment; (d)(1) emergency preparedness, (2) preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, (3) administering medication, (4) preventing and responding to food allergy emergencies and allergic reactions, (5) understanding building and premises safety, and (6) handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
